title: Ford 6.7L CP4 to DCR Pump Conversion
spec_text:
Reliable Fuel System Upgrade for Ford Super Duty Trucks (2011–2025) 

 The factory-installed CP4 high-pressure fuel pump in 2011 to current Ford Super Duty diesel trucks has earned a reputation for sudden failures , leading to power loss and fuel system damage that can result in repairs exceeding $10,000 .

 This widespread issue has resulted in recalls and legal action against manufacturers using CP4 pumps. To provide a long-term solution, S&S Diesel Motorsport™ , the common rail diesel injection experts , teamed up with PurePower Technologies, Inc.® —the aftermarket division of legendary fuel system maker Stanadyne® .

 The result is a revolutionary and durable solution: the Ford 6.7L CP4 to DCR Pump Conversion . This plug-and-play replacement offers OE fit and function while eliminating the risks associated with the CP4 pump.

 Key Benefits & Features 
 
 Eliminates CP4 Failure Risks
